_comment: Firestore only, on purpose. There is deliberately no `hosting` block here.
This site runs on Vercel. Everything under /api is a Node serverless
and none of those can run on Firebase Hosting, which serves static files.
Deploying this directory to Firebase Hosting would put admin.html on the
internet with every request behind it returning 404, which looks like a
broken panel rather than a misconfigured one.
Firebase is used here for three things only: Firestore, Authentication,
and the custom claim that marks an administrator. `firebase deploy` should
only ever push the rules and the indexes:
which is what BACKEND-SETUP.md tells you to run, and what this file makes
possible - without it the CLI has no idea where firestore.rules lives.
